title: Niners part owner agrees to purchase Seahawks

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Niners part owner agrees to purchase Seahawks
sources.description: A group led by Niners limited partner Vinod Khosla has agreed to purchase the Seahawks, with sources telling ESPN the selling price will be a record $9.612 billion. The Khosla family will be required to divest its interest in the 49ers.
